llm.summary: This markdown-only orchestration skill is not malicious, but it can route MCP/subagent workflows and persist workflow context without clear privacy or scoping guardrails.

dimensions.detail: The purpose is coherent: it routes data-heavy MCP/code-execution workflows into patterns, validation, and subagent modules. The capability is high-impact because it can influence tool routing, subagent delegation, and workflow state handling.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill and modules use broad automatic triggers such as code execution, MCP, pattern, validate, check, subagent, and decompose, which could activate the workflow in ordinary conversations without explicit user intent.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: Artifacts are markdown files only, with no executable scripts, declared dependencies, package installs, hooks, or CLI entry point. Static scan and VirusTotal telemetry are clean.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: MCP and subagent coordination is aligned with the stated purpose, and the text includes some limiting guidance such as avoiding simple tasks and checking complexity before invoking subagents.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The coordination guidance recommends external storage of intermediate results, emergency state, and debug logs containing context snapshots, but does not define sanitization, retention, encryption, user consent, or boundaries for sensitive workflow data.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: Install only if you want an agent to actively optimize and route MCP/code-execution workflows. Before using it on private code, credentials, customer data, or proprietary datasets, require explicit activation, disable or tightly control external storage and debug context snapshots, and ensure any workflow data passed to validation or subagents is minimized and redacted.
llm.findings:
[SQP-1] unexpected: The broad trigger concern is supported by artifact text. Automatic activation is disclosed, but the keywords are generic enough to create unintended routing for a high-impact MCP/subagent workflow.
[SQP-2] unexpected: The persistence concern is supported by artifact text. External state storage and context snapshot logging are purpose-related, but under-scoped because the skill does not specify minimization, redaction, retention, or user control.
